append.detail: ── SUPERSEDED 2026-10-06 by ADR-1709 (LIVE-748). The meter numbers this probe pinned were changed by the owner's five-tier ladder, so it now fails by design. Original probe, kept verbatim: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const note=fs.readFileSync("lib/spaces/email-catalog-note.ts","utf8");if(!note.includes("export function emailCatalogNote"))fail("emailCatalogNote is gone");if(!note.includes("PLACEHOLDER_METER_LIMITS.space_email"))fail("email catalog note does not read the email meter");if(!note.includes("SPACE_PLAN_LABEL.business"))fail("email catalog note does not name Business from the plan label");if(/Collective/.test(note))fail("email-catalog-note still types Collective");const cat=fs.readFileSync("lib/admin/modules/space-modules.ts","utf8");if(!cat.includes("emailCatalogNote()"))fail("space.comms no longer reads emailCatalogNote");if(/25,000\/mo on Collective/.test(cat))fail("space.comms still names a Collective send rung");if(/5,000\/mo on Business/.test(cat))fail("space.comms still names the leftover 5,000 Business rung");const meters=fs.readFileSync("lib/pricing/meter-limits.ts","utf8");if(!meters.includes("space_email: { free: 300, business: 25_000 }"))fail("space_email left the 300 / 25,000 ladder");console.log("LIVE-437 ok")'
